items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: And that's when we had Art Blakey and Harold on tenor, and myself

ctx.x: The first of that year was Cab broke up. A little later in the year, about the spring, I went with Bushkin. And then a little later in the spring I went with Fatha. And that's when we had Art Blakey and Harold on tenor, and myself, and Tommy Potter and Benny Green and Fatha, and Ella Jones. So then we played along with this for awhile, and
I kind of liked the band, you know. And the money wasn't bad, you know.
